summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 via /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/true), regenerated initramfs, and verified the module stays blocked both before and after a full node reboot (boot_id changed from e4e401d2... to 19314f32...).
actions_performed: Checked baseline: usb_storage module not loaded on node1
Regenerated initramfs via update-initramfs -u so the blacklist applies at boot
Verified modprobe -n -v usb_storage resolves to the /bin/true stub (load blocked) pre-reboot
Captured pre-reboot boot_id and uptime as baseline
Triggered a native reboot on node1 via backgrounded 'sleep 2; reboot' so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec became available again, observing connection-refused mid-reboot then success
Confirmed boot_id changed post-reboot, proving an actual restart occurred
Re-verified blacklist config, unloaded module state, and modprobe -n -v block persisted after reboot

evidence.summary: Wrote blacklist config, ran update-initramfs, and confirmed modprobe -n -v usb_storage resolves to the /bin/true stub and the module is not in lsmod.

evidence.requirement: Healthy pre-restart baseline with boot identity
evidence.summary: Captured pre-reboot boot_id (e4e401d2-3dd8-48c6-848a-545631b9e229) and confirmed usb_storage still blocked/unloaded before restart.
Backgrounded 'sleep 2; reboot' via sudo -n returned its acknowledgement immediately, before the node disconnected.

evidence.requirement: Proof node actually restarted (changed boot identity)
evidence.summary: First poll showed unchanged boot_id (not yet rebooted), second poll hit connection-refused mid-reboot, third poll succeeded with a new boot_id (19314f32-5049-4381-8b17-76eb20b28120), proving a real restart occurred.
Post-reboot check confirms blacklist config file intact, usb_storage not loaded, and modprobe -n -v usb_storage still resolves to the /bin/true stub.
